title: Refractor Nick Raquet 2017 1st Bowman Chrome Draft #BDC-182 Washington Nats
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare and valuable Refractor Nick Raquet 2017 1st Bowman Chrome Draft trading card. It features the talented baseball player from the Washington Nationals team. The card is a part of the Retro Baseball Cards set and has a unique Chrome parallel/variety. It is perfect for any sports trading card collector, especially those who love baseball.

The card number is BDC-182 and it was manufactured by Bowman in 2017. This sports trading card is a must-have for any fan of the Washington Nationals and baseball in general. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this valuable card to your collection.
